# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Role:** Stableman

## Appearance

Barney Pullen is an elderly man with a weathered, working-class appearance suitable for a lifetime spent working in stables. He typically wears humble, functional clothes associated with his trade.

## Personality

Barney is a practical and quiet individual who takes his responsibilities at the stables seriously. He tends to keep to himself, observing the happenings around him with a reserved demeanor.

## Traits

- Quiet
- Observant
- Dutiful

## Abilities

- Horsemanship and stable management

## Goals

- To maintain his livelihood and attend to his work in the stables

## History

Barney Pullen works as a local stableman, tending to horses and assisting visitors and townspeople with their transport needs. During the events of the first volume, he interacts with travelers passing through and attends to his routine duties around the stables.

## Background by volume

- Has worked as a stableman tending to horses and carriages
